name: Whole assembly
purpose: Every seat resolves to its selected arm or says exactly what to pass, and no consumer wording enters the hub.
record: Cases passed over written assemblies, including each arm and each pending seat.
disadvantages: Passing here does not show the assembly suits a particular consumer.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=import-boundary, registry and status tests with fake arms] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > production [sample=sample | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the production consumer's owner approved the run and each seat under test has a recorded result]

name: Consumer-specific strings found by scan
record: Consumer-specific strings found by scan (target 0). Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.
disadvantages: A scan finds consumer-specific strings, not consumer-specific behaviour written without those words.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_example_consumer.py and tests/test_import_boundary.py pass]

name: Intents whose solutions one paragraph and one diagram explain as the code builds them
purpose: Every intent's solutions are explained by one coherent paragraph and one diagram that match how they relate in the records and in the code, in a hierarchy a reader can take in.
record: Per intent, from `python3 -m esoi.coherence --json`: whether solution_coherence names every solution and states every uses edge in one sentence, the roots (one for the top intent) and the solutions no edge reaches, whether solution_diagram draws exactly the uses edges with what each passes, the share of uses edges with both ends in code that the code shows (an import or the used id or interface named), the share of import edges between the intent's solutions that a uses path covers, the largest fan-out and the depth.
disadvantages: Reads the selected implementation's uses only; the code evidence is an import or a named id, not a proof that one part calls the other; whether the paragraph reads as one line of thought is for the next stage, a model judge, run only when this stage passes and a reader still finds it unclear.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=python3 -m esoi.coherence --gate exits 0 on the committed records after any change to a solution, an implementation's uses or an intent's paragraph or diagram]
